vlm_comparison.uncertainty: 2,000 paired source-clip bootstrap resamples, seed 42; all cases within a sampled clip retained together; ten source clusters
vlm_comparison.scope: Paired annotation-defined collision/pre-event sequences; invalid schemas count as incorrect; does not estimate field incident prevalence or independent VLM truth
vlm_comparison.legacy_policy: All original artifacts and measured service workloads remain unchanged

presentation_windows.interpretation: Joint sampling/context and pre-event-gap policy comparison; not an isolated model architecture effect
presentation_windows.evaluation_scope: Paired annotation-defined windows under verified presentation clocks; continuous event evaluation is a separate endpoint
presentation_windows.uncertainty_scope: Four pointwise source-clip bootstrap contrasts conditional on fitted models and thresholds; no family-wise correction
presentation_windows.default_policy: Retain 500-clip reference binaries and desktop defaults; do not select replacements on test scores

presentation_events.scope: Off-target episodes per accident clip, not independently reviewed normal-camera false-alarm rate
presentation_events.clock: Actual last sampled frame PTS, normalized to the first source frame
presentation_events.uncertainty: Pointwise paired source-clip bootstrap, fixed models/selected thresholds; no refitting or family-wise coverage
presentation_events.default_policy: Retain 500-clip reference binaries and desktop defaults; do not select replacements on test scores

presentation_controls.scope: Diagnostic controls expose temporal dataset structure, not normal-camera operational performance
presentation_controls.uncertainty: Eight pointwise paired clip-bootstrap diagnostic contrasts; fixed models and thresholds; no family-wise correction

constraints.pre_event_definition: Valid context end PTS strictly less than supplied event PTS minus 1 second
constraints.aggregation: Equal weight per clip with at least one eligible context; unsupported clips are disclosed, not assigned zero exposure
constraints.selection_rule: Maximize training-holdout event recall subject to both constraints; ties minimize off-target episodes then maximize threshold; insufficient support or infeasibility remains unselected

positive_context_events.scope: Calibration-motivated follow-up after the previous event study; new continuous-event replays exclude previously replayed sources, but paired-window test scores on these sources were already observed. Pre-event contexts are annotation-derived accident-clip prefixes, not independently reviewed normal CCTV.
positive_context_events.default_policy: Retain 500-clip reference binaries and desktop defaults; do not select replacements on test scores

event_discrimination.scope: Exploratory diagnostic using only corresponding official-TRAIN calibration rows, already used for prior threshold selection. Motivated after observing previous studies, not an untouched confirmatory sample. No fitting, inversion, threshold tuning, model selection or default changes; no new test endpoints computed.

workload.semantics: annotation-free YOLO/ByteTrack plus motion candidate proposal score

review_routing.protocol: Causal source-local overlap coalescing and strict shared token-bucket admission
review_routing.source_window_selection: Concatenated sampled benchmark windows; replay is a capacity workload, not continuous traffic exposure
review_routing.endpoint: Proposal routing and queue accounting; incident recall is evaluated separately

iid.protocol: Causal TCN persistence and episode starts; fixed benchmark clip order, synchronized camera replication, zero inter-clip gap; post-hoc annotation matching at -1/+3 seconds
iid.endpoint: Retention of annotation-matched detected episodes through admission and simulated review-service completion, not VLM classification accuracy
iid.timing_scope: Constant review service equals measured Qwen mean; front-end service times are scenario parameters, not Snapdragon measurements; outstanding reviews remain pending at observation end
